description: Source file defining the VoiceWakeSettings view component for macOS. It manages user interface elements related to voice wake functionalities, including microphone selection, trigger words, language preferences, sounds, and voice wake test interactions. The code incorporates state management, UI rendering, device discovery, and media handling.

classes.name: VoiceWakeSettings
classes.description: A SwiftUI view for configuring voice wake settings, including microphone setup, trigger words, languages, sounds, and testing tools. It manages user interactions, device discovery, and voice recognition configurations.

classes.name: AudioInputDevice
classes.description: Struct representing an audio input device with a UID and name, conforming to Identifiable and Equatable.

classes.name: TriggerEntry
classes.description: Struct representing a trigger word entry with a unique ID and value.

methods.name: loadTriggerEntries
methods.description: Loads trigger words from the app state into local trigger entries for UI management.

methods.name: syncTriggerEntriesToState
methods.description: Synchronizes local trigger entries back to the app state.

methods.name: addWord
methods.description: Adds a new empty trigger word entry.

methods.name: removeWord
methods.description: Removes a trigger word entry by ID.

methods.name: toggleTest
methods.description: Starts or stops the voice wake test based on current testing state.

methods.name: chimeRow
methods.description: Creates a UI row for selecting or playing a chime sound.

methods.name: chooseCustomChime
methods.description: Opens a file dialog to select a custom chime sound file.

methods.name: selectChime
methods.description: Sets the selected chime and plays it.

methods.name: sanitizerTriggers
methods.description: Returns sanitized list of trigger words.

methods.name: textOnlyCommand
methods.description: Extracts a command string from the transcript if it contains a trigger word.

methods.name: loadMicsIfNeeded
methods.description: Discovers and loads available microphone devices, optionally forcing reload.

methods.name: updateSelectedMicName
methods.description: Updates the microphone name in application state based on selected device.

methods.name: scheduleMicRefresh
methods.description: Schedules a microphone device list refresh.

methods.name: loadLocalesIfNeeded
methods.description: Loads supported speech recognition locales if not already loaded.

methods.name: friendlyName
methods.description: Returns a user-friendly name for a given locale.

methods.name: restartMeter
methods.description: Restarts live microphone level measurement and updates the level meter.
